description:
A bold offer from the burly, innocent loan shark Jeong Hyeok-Su to the slender college student Lee Eun-Hu! 50 in one go! What should he do? Jun-Hu, Eun-Hu's troublemaker younger brother, is in big trouble this time. He borrowed money from a loan shark and couldn't pay it back! Eun-Hu stands before Hyeok-Su to pay off his brother's debt, but is completely discouraged when he hears his size and the amount... However, although he boasts in front of Hyeok-Su that he will pay it back, he is at a loss as to how to repay it... No matter how much he pays, there is no end in sight, and Eun-Hu is struggling, so Hyeok-Su makes a secret offer...

Eun-Hu has a hard time understanding Hyeok-Su's offer, and Hyeok-Su can't wait for Eun-Hu's answer. Should he just let it go?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
